title: Score metadata: what the piece is, and what wrote the file
description: One note, and every document-metadata field the lab carries: `_x.mnxLab.work` (title, subtitle, artist, album, four typed creators, copyright, source, notes) and `_x.mnxLab.encoding` (software, version, date). MNX v27 has no document metadata at all — no title, no composer, no rights, no encoding provenance — so these are drafts of the standard root-level objects asked for in w3c-cg/mnx#267 and #547 (see docs/mnx-extensions.md). The engraving is deliberately identical to an untitled document: the printed title is `scores[].name`, which labels a LAYOUT, and nothing in the layout engine reads `work`. This scenario exists so the schema, both converters and the viewer heading have one document that states everything.
